tools.name: fix_subtitles
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to fix subtitle timing or convert subtitles: shift an SRT or VTT file earlier or later, convert it from one frame rate to another (23.976, 24, 25, 29.97, 30, 50, 59.94, 60), sync it on two cues, trim overlapping cues, give short cues a minimum duration, strip formatting

tools.name: check_subtitles
tools.description: Use this when the user asks whether an SRT or VTT subtitle file has problems, or wants a report before fixing it: overlapping cues, zero or negative durations, cues out of order, SRT numbering gaps, empty cues, cues too fast to read (characters per second above max_cps, default 20) and lines longer
